title: Release Tactus package with GPT-5 controls
description:
Publish a Tactus package version containing runtime reasoning_effort and verbosity support so downstream repos can depend on it from package indexes.

Definition of Done:
- Tactus feature branch is merged through the normal review path.
- A new package version is published and installable.
- Release notes mention TactusRuntime reasoning_effort and verbosity support.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Starting release readiness pass: verify changed files, run CI-equivalent gates locally, then commit with semantic feat message and push branch for CI validation.
